text:
alex: Captured a 30s nsys/Perfetto trace for the failing pipeline-splay run, uploading artifacts to gs://perf/1955012378-nsys.zip
infra-bot: nsys capture completed: 30.2s, 1.1GB
sara: quick summary from the trace: KV cache handshake spikes at ~4.5s and ~17s, GPU0 stalls ~25-40ms each time
mike: confirmed. NCCL timeline shows an allreduce on TP-stage-1 overlapping with a long kernel launch on TP-stage-2; looks serialized on stream1
alex: kernel-chooser log excerpt: `chosen_kernel=sm80_matmul_tile128 fallback=sm80_matmul_tile64 when_batch<=8`
toni: is chooser using flops heuristic or the latency model? recent change introduced a "splay" heuristic that biases smaller tiles
sara: splay picks smaller kernels to reduce long-tail for big batches, but here it increases NCCL overlap — per-token latency up ~12% for this run
mike: perfetto flame snippet (annotated):
```
GPU0  [kernel: matmul_tile64] 12.34s-12.40s
NCCL  [allreduce]            12.38s-12.60s  <-- overlap starts
KV    [handshake]            12.35s-12.42s  <-- holds stream0
```
alex: hypothesis: KV handshake is running on the default stream and blocks async memcpys used by NCCL, causing enqueue delays. Also the chooser fallback to tile64 increases runtime at this seq len
sara: can we try disabling KV prefetch for this workload? proposed flags: `--kv-prefetch=false --kernel-chooser=latency`
toni: queued an experiment on dev-gpupool with those flags, job id 1955012405
infra-bot: job 1955012405 started on dev-gpu-12 (4xA100), nsys trace will be uploaded to gs://perf/1955012405-nsys.zip when done
mike: also seeing cudaEventRecord delays on stream2; might be starvation because of stream reorder in persistent-tp. If kernel chooser changes grid dims it could change SM occupancy and NCCL scheduling behavior
alex: good point — changing grid/block dims can alter SM occupancy and how NCCL stripes work; we should correlate kernel SM occupancy with NCCL queue depth and NVLink counters
sara: next steps: 1) run without KV prefetch 2) force `--kernel-chooser=latency` 3) capture perfetto + NCCL trace + nvlink/pcie counters
mike: +1. Also create a small synthetic with fixed seq len to reproduce deterministically (no batching noise)
alex: I'll kick off the synthetic and the flagged run, collect traces, and post back here. Also adding a grep for chooser decisions: `rg "chosen_kernel|fallback" logs/*.log` to quickly find transitions
sara: when you upload traces please include the nsys report and the perfetto JSON so we can open in UI and zoom into the overlap region
mike: note to self: instrument kernel-chooser to emit occupancy estimates in the logs (warp occupation %, sm_occupancy_est)
alex: thanks — will update thread after both traces are in. :thumbsup:
